versions.content: RTEEvent pairing constraint in Software Composition con- text RTEEvent s defined in the context of a CompositionSwComponentType that are mapped by RteEventInCompositionToOsTaskProxyMapping s to the same OsTaskProxy shall be mapped together to the same OsTask. Optionally an order of the RTEEvent s in the OsTaskProxy can be defined with the offset attribute.
